errors.evidence: The figure does not specify that the data is from Germany, even though the language is German.

The legend shows wage brackets in Euro (e.g., "unter 10,45 Euro"), which in the context of the paper's topic on minimum wage implies hourly wages, not "monatlichen Bruttoarbeitslöhnen" (monthly gross wages).
For the category "überwiegend negativ", the dark blue bar ("unter 10,45 Euro") extends beyond the 50% mark to approximately 51%, so it is not within the 40-50 range.

errors.text_span: Die Balken für die Kategorie "keine Auswirkungen" liegen im Bereich zwischen 20 und 30.
errors.evidence: This is incorrect. While the dark blue bar is at ~26% and the medium blue bar is at 30%, the light blue bar ("übrige Betriebe") is at approximately 43%, which is far outside the stated 20-30 range.

errors.text_span: Die Balken für die Kategorien "überwiegend positiv" und "beides in gleichem Maße" liegen im Bereich unter 5.
errors.evidence: This statement is incorrect for the "überwiegend positiv" category. All three bars for this category have values above 5% (approximately 9%, 7%, and 6%).
